speaker: Ma
text: I can't say no to my little tushy face. I'll be back soon. Do you want the regular peas or the maceur?

speaker: Howard
text: Thanks, Ma. Always maceur, peas with lamb stew.

speaker: Ma
text: You're right. When you're right, you're right. What if they're out of the maceur?

speaker: Ma
text: Alright, you don't have to yell.

speaker: Howard
text: Sorry about that. I'm already on vibrate.

speaker: Bernadette
text: Let me just put that on vibrate. Hey, now that one I got. Howard, did you say something to Leonard about me? He says if I go see his experiment tomorrow, it might weird you out.

speaker: Bernadette
text: You're not jealous of Leonard, are you?

speaker: Howard
text: Me? No. I, I may have... Mentioned it's a little inappropriate to be asking another man's girlfriend to his experiment without first discussing it with said man.

speaker: Bernadette
text: Are you saying I need to ask your permission to hang out with Leonard?

speaker: Howard
text: I didn't say anything like that. I said Leonard has to ask my permission. Come on, I don't want to eat lamb stew with my mother. Damn, this close on the girl.
